test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The difference between the compound interest and simple interest on a certain sum at 20% per annum for 2 years is Rs. 9,000. Find the sum.
solution: Formula: In case of SI: SI = (P × R × T)/100 In case of CI: A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T CI = A - P Where, A = Amount, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time Calculation: Let, the principal be 100
